name: Autotrader
description: Autotrader.com (Cox Automotive) US vehicle marketplace: search new, used and certified listings by location, make/model, year, price and mileage; read one listing with pricing, specifications, features and seller; resolve make/model names to codes; facet counts by model year, trim and city; model specifications by style id.

tools.name: Get listing
tools.description: After search_listings, or when the user pastes an autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/vehicle/{id} URL or a VIN.

options.name: listing_id
options.about: Autotrader listing id, e.g. 788577333.

options.name: url
options.about: Autotrader listing URL, https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/vehicle/{listing_id}[?...].

options.name: vin
options.about: 17-character VIN (I, O and Q never occur). Pattern: ^[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}$.

response.about: Read one Autotrader listing by listing id, VIN or listing URL: title, year/make/model/trim, price snapshot with dealer fees and KBB Fair Purchase Price, price history, mileage, colors, powertrain, features by category, specifications, warranties, vehicle-history flags, photos, videos, dates and the seller (dealer name, address, phone, website, rating, hours; private-seller identity is withheld). Not found when the listing has expired.

fields.name: country
fields.about: Always US: autotrader.com lists US inventory only (AutoTrader.ca is a separate product).

fields.name: currency
fields.about: Always USD. Prices are dealer asking prices; dealer fees are listed separately and taxes, title and registration are excluded.

fields.name: date_listed
fields.about: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the listing was first published, or null.

fields.name: description
fields.about:
Seller's full description (may contain
markup) or null.

fields.name: features
fields.about: Feature lists grouped by the site's categories (exterior, interior, safety, technology, ...).

fields.name: image_url
fields.about: Primary photo URL or null.

fields.name: images
fields.about: All photo URLs in site order.

fields.name: kbb_vehicle_id
fields.about: Kelley Blue Book vehicle id for this year/make/model/trim.

fields.name: last_modified
fields.about: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last listing update, or null.

fields.name: listing_id
fields.about: Autotrader listing id; input for get_listing.

fields.name: listing_type
fields.about: NEW, USED or CERTIFIED as stated by the site.

fields.name: make_code
fields.about: Autotrader make code, e.g. TOYOTA.

fields.name: mileage
fields.about: Odometer miles, or null when not stated.

fields.name: model_code
fields.about: Autotrader model code, e.g. CAMRY.

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix epoch milliseconds when this result was fetched.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.about: Seller (dealer) id; same as seller.owner_id.

fields.name: price
fields.about: Snapshot of the listing price; prices change without notice.

fields.name: source_url
fields.about: The API resource this record was read from.

fields.name: specifications
fields.about: Specification rows shown on the listing page.

fields.name: stock_id
fields.about: Dealer stock number or null.

fields.name: style_id
fields.about: Autotrader style id; input for vehicle_specs.

fields.name: title
fields.about: Listing title as shown, e.g. 'Used 2025 Toyota Camry SE'.

fields.name: trim_code
fields.about: Trim code in MODEL|TRIM form, e.g. CAMRY|SE; usable as trim_code in search_listings.

fields.name: url
fields.about: Public listing page, https://autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/vehicle/{listing_id}.

fields.name: vhr_preview
fields.about: Vehicle-history flags from the AutoCheck preview, e.g. NO_SALVAGE_TITLE, ACCIDENTS_REPORTED.

fields.name: vin
fields.about: 17-character VIN or null when not published.

fields.name: warranties
fields.about: Original manufacturer warranties as reported by the site; empty when none are listed.

tools.name: Listing facets
tools.description: To see which years, trims or cities have inventory before searching, or to pick a trim_code for search_listings.

options.name: facet
options.about: model_years, trims or cities.

options.name: listing_type
options.about: Filter by NEW, USED or CERTIFIED (certified pre-owned). Omit for all.

options.name: make_code
options.about: Autotrader make code, e.g. TOYOTA, HONDA, CHEV, MB (resolve free text with suggest_make_model). Pattern: ^[A-Z0-9]{1,20}$.

options.name: model_code
options.about: Autotrader model code, e.g. CAMRY, CIVIC, 911 (from suggest_make_model). Requires make_code. Pattern: ^[A-Z0-9_-]{1,30}$.

options.name: radius_miles
options.about: Search radius in miles around zip; 0 means nationwide. Default 50.

options.name: zip
options.about: 5-digit US ZIP code; ignored by the cities facet. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

response.about: Listing counts and price statistics grouped by model year, by trim or by US city for a make/model (optionally within a radius of a ZIP and a listing type). Model-year and trim facets carry starting, average and maximum asking prices in USD; the cities facet lists the US cities with the most matching listings (nationwide, geographic coverage).

fields.name: count
fields.about: Number of facet values.

fields.name: currency
fields.about: Always USD. Prices are dealer asking prices; dealer fees are listed separately and taxes, title and registration are excluded.

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix epoch milliseconds when this result was fetched.

tools.name: Search listings
tools.description: Discovering vehicles for sale in the US; chain listing_id into get_listing, style_id into vehicle_specs and seller.owner_id into dealer_id. Use suggest_make_model to turn 'Toyota Camry' into make_code/model_code first.

options.name: cursor
options.about: next_cursor from a previous page (the record offset). The site serves at most the first 1000 matches. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,3}$.

options.name: dealer_id
options.about: Restrict to one seller's inventory: the owner_id of a listing's seller.

options.name: end_year
options.about: Latest model year.

options.name: keyword
options.about: Free-text keyword phrase matched against listing descriptions, e.g. 'leather sunroof'.

options.name: listing_type
options.about: Filter by NEW, USED or CERTIFIED (certified pre-owned). Omit for all.

options.name: make_code
options.about: Autotrader make code, e.g. TOYOTA, HONDA, CHEV, MB (resolve free text with suggest_make_model). Pattern: ^[A-Z0-9]{1,20}$.

options.name: max_mileage
options.about: Maximum odometer miles.

options.name: max_price
options.about: Maximum asking price in USD.

options.name: min_price
options.about: Minimum asking price in USD.

options.name: model_code
options.about: Autotrader model code, e.g. CAMRY, CIVIC, 911 (from suggest_make_model). Requires make_code. Pattern: ^[A-Z0-9_-]{1,30}$.

options.name: page_size
options.about: Listings per page, 1-100. Default 25.

options.name: radius_miles
options.about: Search radius in miles around zip; 0 means nationwide. Default 50.

options.name: sort
options.about: Sort order. Default relevance.

options.name: start_year
options.about: Earliest model year.

options.name: trim_code
options.about: Trim code in MODEL|TRIM form as returned by listing_facets(trims) or a listing's trim_code, e.g. CAMRY|SE. Pattern: ^[A-Z0-9_ .|/-]{1,60}$.

options.name: vehicle_style_code
options.about: Body style code, e.g. SEDAN, SUVCROSS, TRUCKS, COUPE, CONVERT, VANS, WAGON, HATCH. Pattern: ^[A-Z_]{1,20}$.

options.name: zip
options.about: 5-digit US ZIP code the search radius is centred on. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

response.about: Search Autotrader vehicle listings within a radius of a US ZIP code, filtered by make/model/trim codes, listing type, body style, price, year, mileage, keyword or seller. Returns one page of listings (id, VIN, title, price snapshot in USD, mileage, colors, powertrain, seller summary, primary photo) plus the total match count and a cursor for the next page. Prices are dealer asking prices; dealer fees are reported separately and taxes/title/registration are excluded.

fields.name: count
fields.about: Listings on this page.

fields.name: country
fields.about: Always US: autotrader.com lists US inventory only (AutoTrader.ca is a separate product).

fields.name: currency
fields.about: Always USD. Prices are dealer asking prices; dealer fees are listed separately and taxes, title and registration are excluded.

fields.name: next_cursor
fields.about: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; null when exhausted or when the site's 1000-record window is reached.

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix epoch milliseconds when this result was fetched.

fields.name: query
fields.about: The filters as applied.

fields.name: source_url
fields.about: The public search page equivalent to this query.

fields.name: total_result_count
fields.about: Total matches reported by the site (may exceed the 1000 records the site will page through).

tools.name: Suggest make model
tools.description: Before search_listings or listing_facets when you have a make/model name rather than codes.

options.name: query
options.about: Prefix of a make or model name, 2-40 characters.

response.about: Resolve a free-text prefix (e.g. 'cam', 'civic', 'f-150') to Autotrader make and model codes, with body-style codes for truck cab variants. Returns the site's suggestions in its ranking.

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix epoch milliseconds when this result was fetched.

tools.name: Vehicle specs
tools.description: After get_listing or search_listings, to read the manufacturer specifications behind a listing.

options.name: style_id
options.about: Autotrader style id, e.g. 453130 (listing.style_id).

response.about: Model information for an Autotrader style id (from a listing's style_id): title, overview text, EPA mpg range, stock photo and specification sections (dimensions, engine, safety ratings, standard/optional equipment) as label/value rows.

fields.name: heading
fields.about: Year make model heading, e.g. '2025 Toyota Camry'.

fields.name: mpg
fields.about: EPA mpg range across the model's trims; null when not published.

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix epoch milliseconds when this result was fetched.

fields.name: title
fields.about: e.g. '2025 Toyota Camry LE'.
